data.name: Fragile Frontier
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Moonperch Island.


You and a single friend are the island's last postal crew, sharing one fragile, aging car across a hand-crafted island swallowed in fog. The cargo is heavy and the road is unforgiving. There is no convoy and no second vehicle - just the two of you, your headlights, and the cold.


Inspired by Easy Delivery Co. and Death Stranding, Fragile Frontier is about atmosphere, weight, and quiet dread - keeping a heavy load secured and a crewmate safe while the world presses in around you.

Load It. Drive It. Lose It. Recover It - On Foot.


  • Cargo on the Roof: Heavy crates are strapped to your one car, shifting its center of gravity with every load
  • A Mistake Costs You: Hit something hard enough and a crate works loose and drops - a real, weighty object in the dark
  • Stop and Recover: No driving over it, no shortcuts. Someone has to stop the car and walk out into the fog to find it
  • Carry It Back: Heft the crate through the terrain and re-strap it to the roof

No instant fail - but every dropped crate costs time, warmth, and fuel out in the mist.

Survive the Route


Three things keep you alive out here, and all of them run down:


  • Warmth: Stray from the cab heater or a campfire and the cold closes in - ice creeps across your vision as you freeze
  • Energy: Long hauls and hard recoveries wear you down. Rest at shelter, or crack an energy drink and push on
  • Fuel: The tank drains as you drive. Refuel at the depot, carry fuel cans, or pay dearly at roadside caches - run dry and you're stranded, and a dead engine won't warm anyone

Two Owls, One Car


  • Driver & Navigator: One drives the blind, fog-bound road; the other reads the dashboard, the paper map, and the landmarks out the window - navigation is entirely in-world, with no compass and no objective markers
  • Recover Together: Someone has to leave the warm cab to retrieve a lost crate - decide who, and for how long
  • One Lifeline: Lose the car and you lose everything - protect it together

Moonperch Island - Vast, Lonely, Uncaring


A hand-crafted island designed to feel isolating: near-deserted village streets around the depot, fog-choked forest roads, weather-worn bridges, exposed hillside switchbacks, and cold coastal paths far from any help. Meet 7 NPC owls - distant, solemn, and quietly in denial about the mountain above them.

Upgrade to Survive


Earn Feathers from hard-won deliveries and invest in staying alive: snow tires and ice chains for the ploughed roads, a reinforced bumper, brighter headlights, a more efficient cab heater, a larger fuel tank, and stronger cargo straps.

Built for Two (and the Lone Owl)


  • 1-2 Players: Crew a single shared car together via Steam online co-op
  • Solo: A lonelier, more demanding version of the same journey
  • Save and Resume: A long haul can be paused and picked up later
  • First-Person Cab: Drive from the cockpit - headlights, wipers, and the radio your only comfort
  • Full controller support, Steam Achievements, and Cloud Saves

Can the two of you carry Moonperch Island's last deliveries through the cold... before the mountain has its say?

data.short_description: A quiet, tense delivery game for 1-2 owls sharing one fragile postal car on a fog-bound island. Haul heavy cargo over unforgiving terrain, manage warmth, energy, and fuel, and walk out into the cold to recover what you drop. Out here, your crewmate and your car are all you have.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core @ 2.5Ghz (e.g., Intel Core i3-4130)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core @ 3.2Ghz (e.g., Intel Core i5-4690)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
